UPDATE users SET
            employee_id = NULL,
            company_id = CASE WHEN company_id = $2 THEN (
                SELECT uc.company_id FROM user_companies uc
                WHERE uc.user_id = users.id
                ORDER BY uc.company_id
                LIMIT 1
            ) ELSE company_id END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE employee_id = $1
            AND deleted_at IS NULL
            AND NOT (roles <@ ARRAY['employee']::VARCHAR(50)[])
